caption_draft:
Your project can have a real link today: 6 free places to put it online.

GitHub Pages — https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/what-is-github-pages — Free for public repositories
Vercel — https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby — 100 deployments a day, free
Netlify — https://www.netlify.com/pricing/ — 300 free credits a month
Cloudflare Pages — https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/platform/limits/ — 500 free builds a month
Render — https://render.com/docs/free — 750 free instance hours a month
Firebase Hosting — https://firebase.google.com/pricing — 10 GB free hosting storage

Save this and put one project online tonight. Send it to the friend whose project only runs on their laptop.

#webdev #hosting #github #vercel #firstyear #students #projects #notyourcollege
